pivHint: The STONE the builders rejected has become the cornerstone, the psalmist says. A gem tied to the month you were born is called a ______stone.
winText: You found it. STONE isn't just a word in today's verse — a gem for your birth month is a BIRTHstone.
lossText: The word was BIRTH. STONE was the pivot — a gem for your birth month is a BIRTHstone.
votdVerse: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
passageText: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes. The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
